subject: PLATFORM: ~83 box configs return null from cls, which Terminal.js turns into a builtin fallthrough
description:
Found while fixing NT1 2026-09-09, confirmed by Nancy. Terminal.js:288-304 treats a STRICT null return from a box command as 'fall through to the built-in handler'. The builtin switch has case 'clear' (Terminal.js:321) but no case 'cls', so execution reaches default: and prints the bash-flavoured '<cmd>: command not found' -- AFTER the handler already cleared the screen. 87 box files override cls; 85 use the buggy 'return null'. The 2 exceptions (mail001-queue-backup, mail002-email-auth) are promptStyle 'linux' and correctly reject cls, which is intentional. Intersecting cls-overriders with windows-prompt boxes gives 51 affected. Fix is one character class: 'return \'\';' instead of 'return null;' -- '' is falsy so nothing prints, but it is not null so there is no fallthrough. NT1 (both copies) is already fixed as the reference. DO NOT add case 'cls' to Terminal.js: that would wrongly 'fix' cls on the genuine Linux-sim boxes too. Detection: grep -l "cls: function.*return null" _app/*/boxes/*/config.js
[2026-09-09 21:57] TRUE SCALE: SHELL-003 (command returns bare null, which Terminal.js reads as 'fall through to the builtin') fires on 114 boxes, not the ~83 previously estimated -- same cause, the linter could not parse a third of the configs. All baselined. One-character class of fix: return '' instead of return null. NT1 is the reference.
